title: Our home and living together
summary: Review rooms at home and ways to help.
keyIdeas: Rooms at home have different uses.
Everyone in the family helps with household tasks.
Saving water and turning off lights help our home and planet.

activities.prompt: The kitchen is used to prepare family meals.
activities.explanation: We keep food and prepare meals in the kitchen.

activities.prompt: Read carefully and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Aisha helps her family by tidying and saving energy.
activities.title: Aisha's home
activities.text: Aisha lives on the third floor of a building. Her home has a kitchen, living room, bathroom and two bedrooms. She likes helping her family. Today, she put her toys away carefully and turned off the hallway lights. Everyone at home helps each day.

questions.prompt: What type of home does Aisha live in?
questions.explanation: Aisha lives on the third floor of a building.

questions.prompt: Why does Aisha turn off the hallway lights?
questions.explanation: Turning off unused lights avoids wasting electricity.
